messages:
sana: Heads-up — noticed ~40 candidates from last week have blank scorecards in Greenhouse after the webhook outage. Can we run a backfill and also confirm interviewer training checklist is up to date?

mike: ugh, saw that. webhook retried but payloads were dropped. I can run a backfill script. Will need a quick OK for a write action to ATS.

alexa: @mike +1 for backfill. also we should lock the interviewer checklist so new hires don't get incorrect instructions. which checklist are we talking about?

jordan: this is the panel-scorecard template (Panel - Technical Interview). Some interviews were created by the loop recruiter flow which didn't attach the template because of the missing mapping.

mike: here's the backfill I used before (small DRY run first):

```
# dry run
python tools/ats_backfill.py --start 2025-10-01 --end 2025-10-07 --dry-run

# apply
python tools/ats_backfill.py --start 2025-10-01 --end 2025-10-07 --apply --notify-recruiters
```

mike: it only touches the scorecard_id field, idempotent if run twice. I'll post results in thread.

alexa: We should also run a quick query to find any interviews missing interviewer guidance docs. I can take that once the backfill is done.

sana: Approved — mike, please run dry run first and paste results. tagging @recruiting-bot to queue a re-import if needed. :thumbsup:

recruiting-bot: import-job queued (job_id: 87432). Estimated time 2m.

mike: dry run done — 42 rows would be updated, no conflicts. sample: Candidate 8091 interview 1203 -> add scorecard Panel-Technical v2.

alexa: great, run apply when ready. I'll hold off on checklist changes until you confirm no other templates are affected.

mike: apply complete. import-job 87432 reported 42 updated. log snippet:

```
2025-11-04T15:12:02Z INFO updated interview 1203 scorecard_id -> panel-tech-v2
2025-11-04T15:12:03Z INFO updated interview 1247 scorecard_id -> panel-tech-v2
```

jordan: confirmed — pulled a random sample, scorecards attached and scoring fields populated. thank you.

sana: next ops item: interviewer training — alexa, can you schedule a 30-min refresh for interviewing rubric + new scorecard fields? propose Wed or Thu next week.

alexa: Thu 10am works for me. I'll send calendar invite to eng interviewers + post checklist doc link in #people-ops.

sana: perfect. leaving a small follow-up: can we add a post-import alert to Slack if >10 interviews updated in a single backfill? helps visibility.

mike: yep, I'll add a lightweight alert in the backfill workflow that pings #people-ops with summary + commit link.

sana: thanks all — closing this thread after calendar + alert are up. :white_check_mark:
